title: Technical Support Engineer / Application Support Engineer - SaaS Product Support
description:
Technical Support Engineer / Application Support Engineer \- SaaS Product Support
 


 Bengaluru \| Hybrid • Full\-time \| UK business hours • Compensation: up to 5 LPA
 





 Technical Support Engineer \| Application Support Engineer \| Product Support \| Software Support \| SaaS Support \| Customer Support \| Ticket Management \| Incident Management
 




 About the role
 


 Script Assist is hiring junior Technical Support / Application Support Engineers to investigate and resolve customer issues within our software platform.
 





 We are primarily looking for people with approximately 6\-24 months of professional support experience who already understand how to work from a ticket queue, respond to customer or user issues, gather information, investigate a problem, follow a support process, escalate appropriately, document what happened and keep ownership until resolution.
 





 You do not need healthcare experience. You do need some genuine professional experience supporting a software application, SaaS product or digital platform.
 




 You may currently be working as a:
 


 •  Technical Support Engineer
 





 •  Application Support Engineer
 





 •  Technical Support Analyst
 





 •  Application Support Analyst
 





 •  Product Support Analyst
 





 •  Product Support Engineer
 





 •  Product Support Associate
 





 •  Software Support Engineer
 





 •  Software Support Analyst
 





 •  Customer Support Engineer
 





 •  Technical Support Associate
 





 •  SaaS Support Analyst
 





 •  SaaS Support Engineer
 





 •  Production Support Analyst
 





 •  Support Engineer
 





 •  Support Analyst
 





 •  Customer Support Analyst
 





 •  Client Support Analyst
 





 •  Technical Customer Support Executive
 





 Your exact title is not important. What matters is that your current or previous work involved responding to software/application support tickets and helping resolve user or customer issues.
 




 About Script Assist
 


 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company. Our software supports complex private clinical and pharmacy services and connects clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams.
 





 Our platform contains many interconnected workflows, users and roles, permissions, statuses, customer data, configuration, integrations and operational processes. Our support team helps customers understand and resolve problems when something does not behave as expected.
 





 Healthcare is a complex environment, but previous healthcare experience is not required. We will teach you the product and healthcare workflows.
 




  





 What you will do
 


 •  Receive and manage customer support tickets.
 





 •  Respond to customers and users clearly and professionally.
 





 •  Investigate reported software problems.
 





 •  Gather the information needed to understand an issue.
 





 •  Reproduce problems where possible.
 





 •  Review application behaviour and available information.
 





 •  Identify straightforward causes and resolutions.
 





 •  Escalate more complex issues with clear notes and evidence.
 





 •  Maintain accurate ticket histories and track issues through to resolution.
 





 •  Communicate updates to customers.
 





 •  Work with Product, Engineering, QA and Operations.
 





 •  Retest issues after fixes.
 





 •  Help maintain support documentation and identify repeated problems.
 





 •  Learn increasingly complex areas of the Script Assist platform.
 




 The type of person we want
 


 You are likely to have approximately 6\-24 months of experience working in some form of software or application support. You already understand what it means to:
 





 •  Work from a queue and manage tickets or cases.
 





 •  Meet response expectations.
 





 •  Ask users the right questions.
 





 •  Document an issue properly.
 





 •  Follow up with another team and escalate when appropriate.
 





 •  Keep customers updated and close issues properly.
 





 You should also have very good spoken and written English, strong attention to detail, good organisation, a logical approach to problems, strong ownership, the ability to learn new software quickly and confidence communicating with customers and colleagues.
 




 Useful experience
 


 •  Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshdesk or Salesforce.
 





 •  CRM or ticketing platforms.
 





 •  Incident management, application support, SaaS support or product support.
 





 •  Software troubleshooting, production support or issue reproduction.
 





 •  Basic SQL, databases, APIs or software testing.
 





 •  Root\-cause analysis.
 





 You do not need all of these.
 




 Healthcare experience
 


 Previous experience with healthcare software, EHR / EMR, HIS / HMIS, Practice Management Systems, clinical software or pharmacy software would be useful, but is not required.
 





 We are deliberately open to strong junior support candidates from other SaaS, fintech, ERP, e\-commerce, workflow, logistics or enterprise software businesses.
 




 What this role is not
 


 This is not primarily desktop or infrastructure support. Experience focused mainly on laptop repair, hardware support, printer support, network support, router / switch administration, Windows installation, NOC monitoring or generic IT helpdesk is less relevant.
 





 We want candidates whose experience is primarily about supporting users of software applications or digital products. This is also not a Software Developer, QA Tester, Automation Tester or Manual Testing role. We are recruiting for Customer / Product / Application Support.
 




 Why join Script Assist?
 


 This is an opportunity to build a career inside a growing international software company. You will work closely with Support, Product, Engineering, QA and Operations and gain experience supporting a sophisticated live SaaS platform.
 





 Strong performers can progress into Senior Technical Support, Product Support, Application Support, Technical Operations, Implementation, Business Analysis, Customer Success, QA or Product.
 




  






 If you already understand ticket\-based software support and want to develop quickly inside a more complex product environment, we would like to hear from you.

description:
*Schneider Digital \| Global IT \| Integration \& API Development Focus*
**About Schneider Electric**
 Schneider Electric (SE) is the global specialist in energy management and automation. SE develops connected technologies and solutions to manage energy and processes in ways that are safe, reliable, efficient, and sustainable. SE provides an integrated approach designed for the reality of the digital economy (Plant\-to\-Plug). The versatile product portfolio addresses all energy needs of industries as well as residential customers worldwide.
   

  

**About Schneider Digital**
 All IT needs for Schneider Electric are managed by a group called Schneider Digital (SD), spread across 303 locations in 60 countries with over 2,300 staff, along with various engagements with all major Global IT Service Providers. Schneider Digital drives the digital transformation agenda of the company by delivering best\-in\-class IT services, platforms, and solutions.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a driven and technically astute DocuSign Application IT Owner \& Integration Analyst to join the Schneider Digital team. This role combines application ownership accountability with deep integration and API development expertise, serving as the central technical authority for the DocuSign platform within Schneider Electric's global IT landscape.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong hands\-on experience in designing, building, and maintaining integrations between DocuSign and enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and other platforms via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware solutions, and event\-driven architectures. You will be responsible for ensuring seamless, reliable, and secure digital agreement workflows across the organization.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Application Ownership
   

  

* Act as the primary IT owner and single point of contact (SPOC) for the DocuSign application across Schneider Electric globally.
* Manage the full application lifecycle including onboarding, configuration, upgrades, renewals, and decommissioning.
* Govern application SLAs, availability, and performance metrics; drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with the DocuSign vendor and internal procurement teams for license management, support escalations, and contract negotiations.
* Maintain comprehensive application documentation including architecture diagrams, integration maps, and runbooks.


 Integration \& API Development
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain integrations between DocuSign and enterprise platforms (Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow etc.) using REST APIs, SOAP, and middleware tools.
* Implement Connect notifications, and event\-driven patterns to trigger downstream business processes in real time.
* Build and maintain integration middleware pipelines using tools such as Azure Integration Services, Dell Boomi, or equivalent platforms.

title: Escalation Manager
description:

Operating within our global follow\-the\-sun coverage model, you are the decisive voice when a Sev1 or critical customer event occurs, rapidly uniting engineering, support, and executive leadership to stabilize complex enterprise scenarios. We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


**What You Can Expect From Us**

* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. **Pure and simple.**

**SAP S/4HANA PP/PPDS Functional Engineer**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore \& Monterrey
   

  

**Grade**
 Signify is currently designing, building and deploying a global greenfield SAP S/4HANA solution. To support the deployment, stabilize operations after go\-live and enable continuous improvement, we are establishing a global application maintenance organization.
   

  

 The
 **SAP S/4HANA PP/PPDS Functional Engineer** 
 will provide functional support for SAP Production Planning and related planning processes in an application maintenance environment. The role focuses on day\-to\-day operational support, incident and service request handling, issue analysis, testing, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The role requires solid SAP PP knowledge and a willingness to further develop practical expertise in embedded PP/DS through project exposure, support activities and collaboration with senior experts.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Provide functional support for SAP S/4HANA Production Planning processes in a global AMS environment.
* Support business users, key users and Business Process Owners in resolving incidents, service requests and functional questions.
* Support core manufacturing planning processes, including demand management, MRP, production orders, capacity planning and planning\-related master data.
* Provide basic support for embedded PP/DS processes, with the expectation to further develop PP/DS expertise through hands\-on work, knowledge transfer and project involvement.
* Perform initial issue analysis, business impact assessment, root cause analysis and coordination with technical teams, senior functional experts or external partners where needed.
* Support change requests and enhancements by performing impact analysis, functional testing, regression testing and documentation updates.
* Work according to ITIL\-based AMS processes, including incident management, request fulfilment, problem management and change management.
* Use support and collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira and Confluence for ticket handling, documentation, issue tracking and knowledge sharing.
* Support local deployments and hypercare activities by helping users adopt the global template and by resolving planning\-related issues after go\-live.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams in areas such as Materials Management, Quality Management, Warehousing, Supply Chain and Manufacturing Execution.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues, proposing improvements and supporting stabilization of the global template.


**Required Experience And Skills**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience in SAP PP implementation, support or application maintenance.
* Good functional understanding of SAP Production Planning processes, including demand management, MRP, production orders, capacity planning and planning master data.
* Basic or practical exposure to SAP embedded PP/DS, or strong willingness and ability to develop PP/DS expertise through hands\-on support and project work.
* Experience working in an AMS, production support or IT support environment.
* Good understanding of ITIL\-based support processes, especially incident management, service request handling, problem management and change management.
* Experience using support and collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira and Confluence.
* Ability to analyze functional issues, communicate clearly with business users and coordinate resolution with other teams.
* Understanding of integration points between Production Planning and related areas such as MM, QM, Warehousing, Supply Chain or Manufacturing Execution.
* Good testing skills, including functional testing, regression testing and support for change validation.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural and highly integrated business environment.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.


**Nice to Have**
* Deeper hands\-on experience with embedded PP/DS in SAP S/4HANA, including detailed scheduling, planning heuristics, alerts, resources, production versions or PDS integration.
* Experience with SAP Digital Manufacturing, MES or shopfloor integration.
* Knowledge of Advanced Variant Configuration.
* Exposure to SAP PM or SAP QM processes.
* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA deployments, rollouts or hypercare.
* SAP certification in SAP PP, PP/DS or related modules.
* Experience working with global templates and standardized business processes.


**Grading Differentiators**
* Good knowledge of SAP PP processes and ability to provide independent functional support within the assigned scope.
* Basic practical understanding of PP/DS and clear motivation to develop stronger PP/DS expertise.
* Ability to resolve standard and moderately complex functional issues in an AMS environment.
* Good understanding of ITIL\-based support processes and disciplined ticket handling.
* Ability to work with business users, key users, IT teams and external partners in a structured and collaborative way.
* Contribution to documentation, knowledge sharing, testing, stabilization and continuous improvement activities.


**Everything we’ll do for you**
 You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000\+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70\+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
   

  

 Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: Product Support Specialist, Education Team (Full time, 1-year contract)
description:
**Company Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, g'day, namaste, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Ready to make meaningful impact? You're in the right place.
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point. Every role supporting Canva contributes to something bigger. Here's what this contract opportunity involves and what we're looking for.
   

  

**Where And How You Can Work**
 This is a
 **12\-month** 
 independent contractor opportunity, where you'll provide services within a defined scope, with the flexibility to shape how you deliver your impact.
   

  

 Designed for a hybrid way of working, this opportunity is remote and open to candidates based anywhere in India, so you can align on key touchpoints with our internal team and our education partners across the country. While it'd be up to you to manage your time, the expected time commitment to deliver these services is approximately
 **40 hours per week.**
**About The Team**
 We're the Canva Education team in India, working to bring creativity, collaboration, and visual communication into classrooms across the country. We partner with state governments, national education bodies, and large school networks to make Canva a safe, inclusive platform for teaching and learning — from rural districts to city schools — always aligned with India's priorities like NEP 2020, foundational learning, and digital equity. AI is an accelerant to our mission to empower the world to design. We're embracing it as a powerful tool to help us move faster, spark ideas, streamline work, and unlock creativity.
   

  

 We're genuinely curious about how people are thinking about and experimenting with new technologies to amplify impact, so you can expect it to come up in conversation during the interview process.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you'll be working on**
 As Canva Education continues to grow, change is part of how we move forward. That means the services you'll provide may evolve, and we'd discuss that with you from time to time.
   

  

 Right now, most schools and school systems find the technical side of getting started harder than it should be — Single Sign\-On, domain verification, and connecting their Google or Microsoft backends can take far longer than anyone would like, and State partnerships often run across several different authentication pathways at once. You'll be the person who makes all of that smooth.
   

  

**You'll Be Engaged To Provide Services Aimed At**
* Guiding school systems and Education Depts through SSO setup, domain verification, and account provisioning, so teachers and students can get into Canva Education quickly and securely.
* Supporting integration with Google Workspace and Microsoft (Entra ID / Microsoft 365\) backends, and troubleshooting authentication, provisioning, and directory\-sync issues end to end.
* Acting as the technical point of contact for State partnership rollouts that run across different authentication pathways, making sure each one lands cleanly.
* Diagnosing and resolving onboarding blockers alongside school IT admins, DIETs, and district teams, and escalating product issues to internal Canva teams (Partnerships, Product, Engineering) when needed.
* Creating clear, localized setup guides and self\-serve resources so schools can onboard with less hand\-holding over time.
* Tracking common support issues and integration patterns, and feeding them back internally to reduce friction at scale.
* Supporting training and enablement for administrators and master trainers on account setup, access management, and everyday troubleshooting.


**Qualifications**
**You're probably a match if**
* You've supported SSO, SAML/OAuth, or identity and access setups before, and you can explain how they work to non\-technical people without losing them.
* You know your way around Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 / Entra ID administration, including domain verification, provisioning, and directory sync.
* You've spent at least 3 years in technical support, implementation, or solutions roles — ideally supporting schools, government systems, or large organizations.
* You stay calm and methodical when an integration breaks, and you're happy owning a problem until it's genuinely fixed.
* You communicate clearly in English and Hindi, both in writing and on calls.
* You're comfortable juggling multiple school systems, timelines, and stakeholders at once, and you flag risks early with a plan to fix them.


**Additional Information**
 Other stuff to know
   

  

 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above \- we still want to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Application Support Engineer** 




**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Onsite at customer location
 



**Maximum CTC:** 
 INR 90,000 per month
 



**Experience Required:** 
 2 to 3 years in relevant technologies
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Application Support Engineer to provide technical support and manage application deployments within a large financial institution in Bangalore.
 



  





 The selected candidate will initially undergo 2 to 3 months of training at the Mumbai office and will subsequently be deployed onsite at the customer location in Bangalore. The role requires flexibility to work according to the customer’s schedule, which may include weekdays, weekends, holidays, and occasional evenings.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide technical support for Windows Servers, APIs, mobile operating systems, and product\-related issues.
* Deploy, configure, and upgrade .NET applications, Angular applications, and APIs using IIS.
* Manage software deployments, service releases, patches, customizations, and application upgrades.
* Troubleshoot production issues involving IIS, Microsoft SQL Server, APIs, Angular applications, SSL certificates, and networking.
* Perform onsite customer visits when required.
* Take ownership of reported issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Provide support through phone, email, and remote\-access channels.
* Ensure strict adherence to defined response and resolution SLAs.
* Maintain a high standard of customer service and communication.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 



* Minimum 2 to 3 years of relevant experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Windows Server, IIS, and Microsoft SQL Server.
* Experience deploying and upgrading .NET applications on IIS.
* Strong troubleshooting capabilities across IIS, APIs, Angular applications, and SQL Server.
* Knowledge of SSL certificates, DNS configuration, and SSL\-related troubleshooting.
* Understanding of networking concepts, including ports, NAT, and port forwarding.
* Experience handling IIS\-related VAPT findings, security remediation, and server hardening.
* Basic scripting knowledge, including SQL.
* Understanding of SQL Cluster and log shipping.

* Basic knowledge of mobile operating systems, including iOS and Android.
* Exposure to DevOps practices.

**Mandatory Requirements** 



* The candidate must currently reside in Bangalore. Candidates requiring relocation will not be considered.

**Interested and eligible candidates may apply directly through LinkedIn Easy Apply.**

 At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

 \- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one\-to\-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
   

  
   

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** 
 \- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3\-year savings plan.  
   

  
   

**Physical Wellbeing** 
 \- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
   

  

**About Us**
 At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
   

  
   

  At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
   

  
   

  We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

 to join our Infrastructure Services team.

 The successful candidate will work closely with customers, consultants, support teams, and project stakeholders to ensure stable, secure, and high\-performing environments while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence.

* Configure, maintain, and support customer ERP environments, including abas ERP systems.
* Administer and maintain Linux\-based server infrastructures and related technologies.
* Manage virtualization platforms and associated infrastructure components.
* Perform system health checks and proactive maintenance activities.
* Ensure infrastructure reliability, availability, and performance.

* Install and configure ERP application updates, patches, service packs, and upgrades.
* Perform Linux operating system updates and maintenance activities.
* Support customer migrations, platform upgrades, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.

 Monitoring \& Performance Optimization
   

  

* Monitor systems, services, and infrastructure components to identify and address issues proactively.
* Conduct performance analysis, capacity planning, and system optimization activities.
* Investigate infrastructure bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
* Implement best practices for system stability, security, and operational efficiency.


 Customer Support \& Communication
   

  

* Act as a technical point of contact for customers regarding infrastructure\-related topics.
* Coordinate maintenance activities, upgrades, and service requests with customers.
* Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Support incident resolution and collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely issue resolution.


 Collaboration \& Project Delivery
   

  

* Work closely with Consulting, Helpdesk, Professional Services, and Development teams.
* Participate in customer projects, infrastructure implementations, and cloud initiatives.
* Support project planning, execution, and post\-implementation activities.
* Contribute technical expertise to cross\-functional project teams.


 Remote Access \& Security Administration
   

  

* Manage and maintain customer remote support and maintenance connections.
* Support network connectivity, firewall configurations, and secure remote access solutions.
* Ensure compliance with security and operational standards.


 Knowledge Sharing \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Document processes, standards, and technical procedures.
* Provide knowledge transfer and mentoring to team members.
* Contribute to the development of best practices and service improvements.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.


 Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Secondary education diploma, technical degree, or equivalent professional experience in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.


**Experience**
* 3\-5 years of professional experience in Infrastructure Services, Linux System Administration, Managed Services, or a comparable technical role.


 Technical Skills \& Knowledge
   

  

* Strong experience in Linux system administration, server infrastructure, and operating system architecture.
* Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper\-V, Proxmox, or similar platforms.
* Experience managing enterprise application environments and supporting business\-critical systems, including ERP and related infrastructure.
* Proven experience performing system upgrades, patching, maintenance, troubleshooting, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Solid understanding of system monitoring, performance analysis, and optimization techniques.
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and remote connectivity solutions.
* Experience with remote access, remote support, and customer maintenance technologies.
* Familiarity with Active Directory, Docker, and modern infrastructure technologies is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and within cross\-functional teams while maintaining a structured, quality\-focused approach.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience supporting ERP systems, preferably abas ERP.
* Knowledge of Docker and container technologies.
* Experience with Active Directory and Windows Server administration.
* Familiarity with cloud\-hosted environments and managed services.
* Experience working within customer\-facing consulting or professional services organizations.
* German language skills are considered an advantage.


****Professional Skills****
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Structured and solution\-oriented approach to work.
* High level of attention to detail and quality.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.

title: Service Desk
description:
**Job Summary**
**Job Description**
 The Support Executive is responsible for handling customer queries, coordinating issue resolution, maintaining service records, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day support operations. The role primarily focuses on communication, coordination, and process management. The support Executive serves as a key liaison between customers, internal teams, and management to ensure timely response and resolution of requests. The position also involves tracking service tickets, ensuring adherence to SLAs, preparing reports, and maintaining documentation to support overall operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for all non\-technical customer and internal staff queries.
* Ensure timely response and resolution of requests in line with defined SLAs.
* Log, categorize, and track all incoming service requests, ensuring proper documentation and closure.
* Handle Sapphire Call Logging process and follow up on all calls until closure.
* Manage OEM call login process (RAM \& TAC coordination) and ensure timely escalation/resolution.
* Oversee faulty pickup and swapping process, coordinating with logistics and vendors as required.
* Coordinate with engineers, vendors, and other stakeholders for issue resolution and status updates.
* Follow up on pending requests and escalate unresolved issues to the concerned authority.
* Maintain accurate service records, reports, and communication logs.
* Prepare and share daily, weekly, or monthly reports to monitor query trends and service performance.
* Coordinate with engineers, vendors, and customers for PM (Preventive Maintenance) activities.
* Collect and track CSAT (Customer Satisfaction) feedback ratings to measure service quality.


**Required Skills**
**Job Requirements**
* Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Experience in service desk coordination and ticket management.
* Knowledge of SLA management and escalation procedures.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting, and documentation.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple stakeholders effectively.
* Strong follow\-up and problem\-resolution skills.

* Working knowledge of MFA, Office 365, Exchange, WEBEX, and TeamViewer

* Accountable for team performance, quality of deliverables, and proper utilization of tools and resources, ensuring adherence to safety standards

title: Installation Engineer
description:
**About The Job**
 We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Installation Engineer to independently execute and oversee complex server and network deployments supporting enterprise physical security systems. In this mid\-level role, you will take ownership of installation projects, configure advanced infrastructure components, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure seamless integration between servers, network equipment, and security endpoints. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including physical security installers and sustaining operations, while mentoring junior engineers. This position demands strong technical expertise in Dell server platforms and Cisco networking, along with the ability to provide 24x7 support in a globally distributed environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead hardware provisioning activities, including advanced RAID configuration and disk array optimization, to meet performance and redundancy requirements for high\-write\-volume security applications such as video storage systems.
* Configure and validate Integrated Dell Remote Access Controller (iDRAC) and Lifecycle Controller settings, ensuring firmware baselines are established using Dell OpenManage before OS deployment.
* Independently deploy operating systems via PXE boot automation or iDRAC Virtual Media methods, including Windows Server and hardened Linux distributions, ensuring compliance with corporate standards.
* Design and implement network segmentation strategies using VLANs and dedicated subnets to isolate physical security traffic (CCTV, PIDS, Intercom) from management networks.
* Configure Quality of Service (QoS) policies on Cisco Catalyst switches to prioritize high\-bandwidth video streams, ensuring low latency and minimal packet loss for live monitoring and retention systems.
* Manage Power over Ethernet (PoE/PoE\+) budgeting and monitoring on access layer switches, ensuring reliable power delivery to IP cameras, door readers, and security panels.
* Implement network device hardening best practices on Cisco IOS devices, including Access Control Lists (ACLs), disabling unnecessary services, and securing management protocols (SSH/HTTPS).
* Coordinate with network engineers and physical security installation teams to validate network readiness, port activations, and successful device\-to\-server communication paths.
* Execute comprehensive validation testing, including bandwidth saturation tests, physical layer distance checks, and latency measurements, before operational handoff to sustainment teams.
* Develop detailed documentation, including logical and physical topology diagrams, VLAN matrices, IP assignment records, and configuration backups.
* Provide 24x7 technical support for all in\-scope infrastructure systems, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions for medium\-complexity issues.
* Deliver weekly project status updates and maintain programming sheet validations, as\-built documentation, and asset management system accuracy throughout the deployment lifecycle.


**Required Skills**
* Related field experience with 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise server and network infrastructure deployment.
* Strong expertise in Dell PowerEdge server platforms, including RAID controllers (PERC), iDRAC configuration, firmware management, and Lifecycle Controller operations.
* Proficient in Cisco networking technologies, including Catalyst switches, VLAN configuration, QoS implementation, PoE management, and IOS security hardening.
* Solid experience with Windows Server and Linux operating system deployment, administration, and troubleshooting in enterprise environments.
* Working knowledge of scripting languages (Python, PowerShell) and automation tools for configuration management and deployment acceleration.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical teams and provide mentorship to junior engineers while working in 24x7 rotational support models.


**Tools Required**
* Server \& Hardware Tools: Dell iDRAC, Lifecycle Controller, Open Manage, and RAID/PERC utilities for server provisioning, firmware baselining, and remote management.
* OS Deployment Tools: PXE boot infrastructure, iDRAC Virtual Media, Windows Server \& Linux ISOs with hardening and automation scripts.
* Network Tools: Cisco IOS CLI, PoE management, VLAN/QoS configuration tools, network monitoring, and bandwidth/latency testing utilities.
* Automation \& Operations Tools: Ansible, Python, CMDB systems, configuration backup tools, and documentation/diagramming platforms for global 24x7 operations.

* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies
* Experience in manufacturing, automotive, or CPG domain

**What Makes You Eligible**

title: First Line Team Lead
description:
**WirelessCar’s Journey** 
 WirelessCar empowers the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and delivering cutting\-edge digital services. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Sweden, we have a strong global presence with offices in the U.S., China, Germany, India, and Japan, offering a truly global workplace with exciting opportunities for career growth. Owned by Volkswagen Group, today we connect over 17 million vehicles across 100\+ countries and partner with leading OEMs, including Volvo, Jaguar Land Rover, Volkswagen Group, Nissan, and Subaru.
   

  

**About the role** 
 We are looking for a First Line Team Lead who thrives on driving operational excellence and leading people in a dynamic environment. You will coordinate daily service operations, maintain high service standards, and ensure seamless delivery aligned with business priorities and SLAs. You combine exceptional leadership and communication skills with an organized, proactive mindset, taking ownership of team performance while fostering an engaged, collaborative culture.
   

  

 Here’s what you’ll focus on:
   

  

* Lead, coach, and support the daily activities of the First Line support team.
* Translate operational strategy into clear priorities, managing shift schedules and seamless handovers.
* Coordinate daily workloads and prioritize cases to strictly maintain SLAs and service quality.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to align processes and share customer insights.
* Build, document, and maintain knowledge\-base content and standardized work instructions.
* Onboard, train, and mentor new and existing team members to foster continuous growth.
* Regularly review team performance, identifying and driving process improvements.


**We offer you**
* A people\-focused company with healthy work\-life balance and a hybrid workplace.
* Flat organizational culture, founded on Nordic leadership values with trust and autonomy; at WirelessCar, you are not just a number.
* High\-tech company with cutting\-edge products \& services that offers an exciting working environment.
* Plenty of possibilities for growth in your role and career and a global workplace across Sweden, Germany, China, US, Japan, and India.
* Involvement with Electric Vehicle services and products that drive sustainability for our society.
* Tech fund where you pick your choice of tech tools.


**We believe that you bring** 
 You are a structured, empathetic leader who excels at organizing daily operations and supporting team growth. You communicate with clarity, adapt quickly to changing business priorities, and step forward to resolve operational bottlenecks. As a First Line Team Lead, you build strong relationships across internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring operational feedback is seamlessly converted into practical process improvements. You take pride in high\-quality service delivery, promote a strong customer\-first mindset, and build a positive, supportive environment where your team can perform at its best.
   

  

**Additional Required Competencies**
* 6\-12 years of experience in a leadership role within customer support or service operations
* Proven ability to inspire, coach, develop, and motivate team members
* Strong planning, coordination, and prioritization skills to manage workloads and maintain SLAs
* Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Hands\-on experience creating, updating, and structuring operational workflows and knowledge bases
* At least a bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, IT, or a related field


**Beneficial Competence**
* Good understanding of ITIL principles and processes
* Experience managing or coordinating a 24/7 service desk or support operation
* Familiarity with ticketing tools or automotive/connected vehicle services
* Experienced in navigating and collaborating within international environments
* Proven ability to thrive in flat organizational structures with minimal hierarchy
* Background in working for global companies with diverse teams and cultures


**Way of working** 
 The work location for this role is in our office in central Bangalore, India. At WirelessCar we believe in a hybrid work setup, with possibilities to work both from home and from the office.
   

  

**Recruitment process** 
 Ready to help shape secure mobility solutions for the future? Apply now and join our journey! The application deadline is 30\-08\-2026\.
   

  

*Note before you apply:*
* Our company language is English so please write your application in English.
* A cover letter is not required. Instead, you'll answer a few questions to help us better understand your experience and ambitions.

title: Service Manager, elluminate Services
description:
**Overview**
 As a Service Manager at eClinical Solutions, you will be the operational backbone of client engagements ensuring every aspect of the elluminate® platform service runs smoothly, reliably, and to the highest standard. Based in our Bangalore office, you will own day\-to\-day service operations for an assigned portfolio of global clients, coordinating people, processes, and systems across time zones to keep delivery on track and clients confident in eClinical’s partnership.
   

  

 Accelerate your skills and career within a fast\-growing company while impacting the future of healthcare.
   

  

**Key Tasks \& Responsibilities**
* Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring all service activities are running smoothly and issues are addressed promptly
* Monitor ongoing delivery of elluminate® platform services across assigned accounts, proactively identifying and resolving operational gaps before they affect the client
* Coordinate day\-to\-day activities across internal teams — including Engineering ( Tier 3 R\&D), Tech Services (Tier 2\), IT (Infrastructure), Product Development, Implementation Team, Customer Success and Product Support — to ensure seamless, timely service execution
* Track open action items, outstanding deliverables, and client requests across all active engagements; follow through until each item is fully resolved
* Serve as the escalation point for operational issues, triaging problems quickly and mobilizing the right internal resources for resolution
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams across US, India, and other regions, accommodating cross\-time\-zone coordination as needed
* Participate in the transition of accounts from the Implementation team to steady\-state service delivery, ensuring continuity of knowledge, documentation, and client experience throughout the handover process
* Ensure all service activities adhere to agreed\-upon SLAs, quality standards, and regulatory requirements including ICH/GCP guidelines and 21 CFR Part 11
* Conduct regular operational reviews of active engagements, reviewing delivery metrics, identifying trends, and driving corrective actions where needed
* Maintain thorough and accurate service documentation, including status reports, issue logs, meeting notes, and delivery records
* Support audit readiness by ensuring client\-facing deliverables and internal processes meet required compliance and quality benchmarks
* Actively participate in internal and client\-facing audit activities, including the preparation, review, and management of Notes to File (NTF) and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) documentation
* Track CAPA commitments through to closure, coordinating with relevant internal teams to ensure actions are completed on time and evidence is properly documented
* Participate in regular client operational meetings, providing clear and accurate updates on service status, open items, and upcoming milestones
* Communicate service changes, delays, or risks to clients in a timely and professional manner, always paired with a resolution path
* Gather and document client operational feedback; relay themes internally to help improve processes and service delivery
* Ensure the client experience is consistent and well\-coordinated across all touchpoints, from onboarding through steady\-state service delivery
* Identify inefficiencies in service workflows and work collaboratively with internal teams to implement practical improvements
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, runbooks, and service delivery templates
* Maintain up\-to\-date records in project management and service management systems to ensure full visibility into account status across the organization


**CANDIDATE’S PROFILE**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree required; field in life sciences, health sciences, information systems, or a related discipline preferred
* 5\+ years of experience in a service/project management, service/project delivery, or operations role within the life sciences, clinical research, or health technology sector preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; ability to work confidently with global stakeholders across the US, Europe, and Asia Pacific
* Comfortable working in shifts or flexible hours to overlap with US and European client time zones as required
* Detail\-oriented and process\-driven; comfortable working within defined frameworks while identifying opportunities to improve them


**Technical Skills \& Experience**
* Hands\-on experience managing the operational delivery of technology\-enabled services in a regulated clinical environment
* Solid understanding of clinical data management concepts, clinical trial operations, ICH/GCP guidelines, and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements
* Experience working with or supporting EDC systems (e.g., Medidata Rave, Veeva Vault EDC) or clinical data platforms strongly preferred
* Strong organizational skills with a proven ability to track multiple concurrent workstreams, deliverables, and open items without dropping the ball
* Proficient with Microsoft 365 applications (Teams, Outlook, Excel, Word, SharePoint) and familiarity with project (SmartSheet) or service management tools (Service Now, Zendesk)
* A dependable team player who takes ownership of outcomes and thrives in a fast\-paced, client\-focused environment

title: SENIOR DOMAIN ANALYST - SAP
description:
Description:
 



  
 



 We're looking for an individual to support the HR technical AMS team aligned to SAP HR integration and ABAP support, with a strong focus on Business Integration Builder (BIB) for HR master data and organizational data replication.
 



 Monitor, maintain, and support BADIs related to BIB, resolving incidents and enhancing custom business logic during data integration and replication.
   

 Provide production support for IDocs related to HR Mini Master, including troubleshooting and resolving PA and OM segment processing errors within SLA timelines.
   

 Support and maintain custom BADIs managing IDoc transfer between S/4HANA and ECC systems, ensuring data consistency across landscapes.
   

 Debug, fix, and optimize ABAP programs, enhancements, and reports supporting HR technical processes as part of ongoing AMS support.
   

 Apply ABAP on Cloud concepts (e.g., RAP, Steampunk) to support and maintain integration and extension objects where applicable.
   

 Provide HR\-related functional and technical guidance to the broader support team, acting as a point of contact for incident and ticket resolution.
   

 Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents related to BIB configuration, BADIs, and IDoc processing across SAP landscapes within agreed SLAs.
   

 Collaborate with functional HR consultants, Basis, and cross\-application teams to support root\-cause analysis, testing, and issue resolution.
   

 Hands\-on experience supporting and troubleshooting BIB scenarios for HR data in a production/AMS environment.
   

 Experience on at least one AMS/support project involving IDoc\-based data transfer between S/4HANA and ECC systems, with a good understanding of SLA timelines for incidents and requirements.
   

 Good understanding of HR Mini Master data structures (PA/OM) and related IDoc processing.
   

 Strong communication skills to operate in a virtual environment and manage expectations with internal and external stakeholders.
   

 Experience working in large, remote teams.
   

  
 



 Technical and Professional Requirements
 



 Relevant experience: 6\+ years of AMS/production support experience on the SAP HR technical landscape.
   

 Mandatory skills: Business Integration Builder (BIB) support; BADIs related to BIB; IDocs related to HR Mini Master; custom BADIs for IDoc transfer between S/4HANA and ECC; ABAP support/development; and ABAP on Cloud.
   

 Experienced in supporting, troubleshooting, and maintaining BIB scenarios, including BADI fixes for HR data integration issues.
   

 Experience maintaining IDoc configuration, partner profiles, and reporting setup for HR Mini Master data exchange as part of AMS support.
   

 Extensive working knowledge of IDoc\-based integration support between SAP S/4HANA and ECC systems for HR data.
   

 Experience with SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) or PI/PO for HR data integration is an added advantage.
   

 Working experience with ITIL\-based AMS support methodology (incident, problem, and change management).
   

 Preferred Skills
 



 Technology \> SAP Technical \> ABAP / BIB / IDocs (AMS Support).
 



 Qualifications
 



 Bachelor's degree and 3\-6 years of relevant work experience.
   

 Experience with SAP ABAP development, BADIs, and IDoc\-based integration technologies.
   

 Strong problem\-solving skills and a consultative approach, with the ability to collaborate on best practices.
   

 Builds strong relationships with stakeholders and vendors.
   

 Comfortable working in a dynamic, complex, client\- and team\-focused environment with minimal oversight and an agile mindset.
   

 Detail\-oriented, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
   

 Experience working in large or remote teams, with good client\-interfacing skills.
   

 Proficient in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, OneNote, Word, Teams).
   

 Knowledge of the professional services industry preferred.

 We are seeking an experienced SAP SCM professional with proven ECC expertise and strong service management experience, combined with hands\-on knowledge of S/4HANA transformation. As a key member of the Core ERP team within Digital Services, you will ensure operational excellence, service stability, and continuous improvement across the SAP landscape. The role involves close collaboration with business stakeholders, AMS partners, and project teams to support ECC operations, drive automation and process optimization, and enable a seamless transition to S/4HANA — delivering scalable, efficient, and high\-quality ERP services that support Signify’s global business transformation.
   

  

**About Signify**
 Through bold discovery and cutting\-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.
   

  

 At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125\+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.
   

  

 Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world. You light the way.
   

  

**About Digital Services**
 Digital Services is the run organization within Digital, responsible for the day\-to\-day operations of our global application and technology landscape. Beyond ensuring business continuity, the team drives continuous improvement in efficiency, effectiveness, and service quality, working closely with Vendor Management, IT Procurement, and Legal.
   

  

 As an orchestration capability, Digital Services manages and governs services across Application Services and Technology Services, ensuring that operations, suppliers, and projects function as one integrated ecosystem. The function follows ITIL best practices, focusing on end\-to\-end service lifecycle management — from service design and transition to operation and improvement.
   

  

 Each service domain is led by a Service Owner, accountable for service delivery, continuous improvement, and lifecycle management in close alignment with Product Owners and business stakeholders.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The SAP SCM Consultant / Business Analyst will be a key member of the Core ERP (Digital Services) in\-house team, responsible for managing and improving SAP Supply Chain Management (SCM) solutions across the enterprise. This role bridges functional consulting, business analysis, and AMS coordination, ensuring operational excellence while enabling strategic improvement initiatives.
   

  

 The consultant will initially work on the existing ECC landscape, supporting ongoing operations, AMS activities, and continuous improvement. Over the coming years, as the organization transitions to FORCE S/4HANA, the role will evolve to support the phased migration from ECC to S/4HANA — ensuring smooth template transition, data readiness, and alignment of business processes across both platforms.
   

  

 Reporting to the Service Owner, the consultant will act as the functional and technical liaison between internal teams and the AMS partner, driving high\-quality service delivery while promoting automation, innovation, and operational excellence. This role is ideal for a service\-oriented professional with strong SAP SCM expertise and a passion for scalable, efficient service operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Service Management \& Operational Excellence
* Own and drive the day\-to\-day delivery of SAP SCM services, ensuring alignment with SLAs and business expectations.
* Guide the AMS partner in following structured service delivery practices, ensuring compliance with agreed SLAs and continuous improvement targets.
* Lead ITSM process maturity across incident, problem, change, and request management areas.
* Ensure service stability by proactively identifying risks, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.
* Application Management \& Support (AMS)
* Serve as the functional lead within the Core ERP AMS team for SCM\-related modules (MM, PP, QM, LE, EWM, TM).
* Collaborate with the AMS partner to manage incidents, problem tickets, and service requests.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring or high\-impact issues, implementing permanent corrective actions.
* Safeguard and maintain the ERP global template and ensure alignment of enhancements with corporate standards.
* Continuous Improvement, Automation \& Innovation
* Identify and automate repetitive manual processes to improve service efficiency.
* Lead process improvement initiatives leveraging Lean and automation principles.
* Contribute to the SCM roadmap and modernization efforts, aligning with Digital Services’ innovation goals.
* Drive adoption of new tools and techniques to improve service reliability and operational agility.
* Project Participation \& Transformation
* Act as the SCM functional expert during SAP S/4HANA transition and implementation projects.
* Support blueprinting, configuration, testing, and cutover activities for rollouts or enhancements.
* Collaborate with project teams to ensure ECC\-to\-S/4HANA migration readiness and smooth transition.
* Contribute to post–go\-live stabilization and hypercare support.
* Collaboration, Governance \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Work with Service Owners, Product Owners, and Business Process Owners to align service delivery with business priorities.
* Actively participate in CABs, service review boards, and governance sessions.
* Mentor team members and promote knowledge sharing within Digital Services and AMS teams.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders by translating technical service topics into business outcomes.
* Financial Management
* Support cost optimization initiatives and execute service improvement plans to enhance operational efficiency.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8 \- 10 years of hands\-on experience in SAP SCM modules (MM, PP, QM, LE, or EWM/TM).
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Supply Chain processes (Plan\-to\-Produce, Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash).
* Proven track record in SAP AMS or support environments, including change management and problem analysis.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA functionality and integration across domains.
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills; able to drive root cause identification and permanent fixes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, global environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a hybrid AMS model (in\-house \+ partner\-managed).
* Knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies for process optimization.
* SAP certification in SCM or S/4HANA modules.
* Experience with RPA, integration, or automation use cases within ERP processes.
* ITIL Foundation certification (or equivalent understanding of service management processes).


 Location \& Work Mode
   

  

 Primary Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Work Mode: Work from Office Only
   

  

 Critical Experiences
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Hands \-on experience in software development or IT solutions, focusing on translating business requirements into functional specifications.
* Certification in Agile methodologies such as Scrum Master or Product Owner is good\- to\-have for effective collaboration and project management.


**Everything we’ll do for you**
 You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000\+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70\+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
   

  

 Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
**About Airbound**
**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**
 This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.
   

  

 The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.
   

  

 To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're hiring our first dedicated in\-house IT Support Engineer to own day\-to\-day IT operations across the company from keeping every laptop and application running smoothly, to helping us build a more secure, resilient IT environment as we scale. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role: you'll be the go\-to person for \~140 end\-user systems (Windows and Mac), our Google Workspace environment, office networks across two sites, and a growing set of security controls (endpoint protection, firewall, single sign\-on, and more) that we're rolling out over the next few months.
   

  

 You'll work closely with an external Cybersecurity \& GRC consultant during the initial rollout phase and take ownership of ongoing operations once controls are in place.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**End\-user support**
* Be the first point of contact for all IT issues, hardware, software, connectivity, and access across Bengaluru and Guntur
* Set up, configure, and maintain laptops/desktops (\~90% Windows, \~10% Mac) for new joiners and existing staff
* Maintain a basic IT asset inventory (devices, licenses, warranties)


**Network \& infrastructure**
* Maintain and troubleshoot office network infrastructure, including wireless access points across both sites
* Support the rollout and ongoing management of firewall infrastructure and backup internet connectivity
* Liaise with ISPs and hardware vendors for installations, upgrades, and issue resolution


**Security operations (in partnership with our GRC consultant)**
* Deploy and maintain endpoint protection (AV/EDR) across all systems
* Administer single sign\-on (SSO) and manage access provisioning/de\-provisioning across business applications
* Implement and enforce USB/device control policies
* Support periodic access reviews and basic security hygiene checks (patching, password policies, MFA)


**Workplace systems**
* Administer Google Workspace (user accounts, groups, shared drives, permissions)
* Support AWS\-related access requests in coordination with engineering (no infrastructure ownership expected)
* Maintain documentation for common IT processes, so support isn't dependent on one person's memory


**Qualifications**
**Must\-Have**
* 3–5 years of experience in an IT support, systems administration, or helpdesk engineering role, ideally in a small\-to\-mid\-sized company where you owned the function end\-to\-end
* Hands\-on experience supporting both Windows and Mac environments
* Working knowledge of Google Workspace administration
* Basic networking fundamentals (Wi\-Fi, firewalls, VPNs, troubleshooting connectivity issues)
* Exposure to endpoint security tools (antivirus/EDR) and access management concepts, deep security expertise not required, willingness to learn and follow a consultant\-designed framework is
* Comfortable being the sole on\-the\-ground IT person, self\-directed, methodical, good at triaging and prioritizing
* Clear communicator who can support non\-technical colleagues patiently and without jargon
* Willingness to travel periodically to field operations


**Good to Have**
* Prior experience in a manufacturing, hardware, or field\-operations environment
* Familiarity with AWS basics (IAM users, S3 permissions)
* Experience with MDM tools or device management platforms


**Work location:** 
 Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters) \| With periodic travel to field operations in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh)
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Comprehensive health insurance to keep you and your loved ones covered
* Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend to ease your commute
* Advanced salary credit to support you when you need it


 “A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive \-
 **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** 
 from the ground up”
   

  

**Work Schedule**
* In\-office role, working alternate Saturdays.


 Ready to take off?
   

  

**Scam Notice:** 
 Beware of impersonators collecting fees for interviews \& jobs at Airbound (Opendrone Private Limited) Please do not make any payments and report any such incidents to us at contact@airbound.com .

description:
**About Ascendion**
 Ascendion is a leader in AI\-powered software engineering, helping businesses innovate faster, smarter, and with greater impact. We partner with Global 2000 clients across North America, UK, Europe, and APAC to solve complex challenges in data, experience design, software product engineering, and workforce transformation. Powered by expert engineers, thousands of AI agents, and our Engineering to the Power of AI™ (EngineeringAI) method, we deliver measurable outcomes that build trust, unlock value, and accelerate growth. Learn more at ascendion.com
   

  

 Ascendion \| Engineering to elevate life
   

  

 We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:
   

  

* Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
* Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
* Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
* Master your craft with leading training programs and hands\-on experience


**Experience a community of change makers!**
 Join a culture of high\-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Role :** 
 Service Desk Engineer – L2
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India (on\-site)
   

  

* Role Overview


 We are seeking an experienced Service Desk Engineer (L2\) to deliver second\-level technical support to a geographically distributed employee base. The position is based in India and forms part of a follow\-the\-sun global service desk that provides continuous coverage to users located across India as well as international locations including the United States, the United Kingdom, the Philippines and Mexico.
   

  

 The successful candidate will act as the primary point of escalation for incidents and service requests that cannot be resolved at L1, taking end\-to\-end ownership from diagnosis through to resolution and closure. The role demands strong hands\-on technical capability across end\-user computing, endpoint management and endpoint security platforms, combined with the maturity to communicate effectively with users of varying technical proficiency and with senior stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
   

  

 This is a delivery\-focused, customer\-facing role within IT Operations. It requires disciplined adherence to ITIL\-aligned processes, consistent achievement of service level agreements, and a proactive contribution to problem management, knowledge management and continual service improvement.
   

  

* Scope of Support and Global Coverage
* The role is based in India; however, the supported user community is global. Support is delivered remotely to employees across all operating locations.
* Primary user base: employees across multiple office locations and remote sites within India.
* International user base: employees located in the United States, the United Kingdom, the Philippines and Mexico.
* Coverage is provided on a 24x7 rotational shift model, with shift allocation aligned to the business hours of the regions being supported (including North American, European and APAC time windows).
* All support is provided in English, using remote support tooling, voice, chat, email and the enterprise ticketing platform. No international travel or relocation is required.
* The engineer is expected to remain aware of regional public holidays, local business calendars and site\-specific requirements when planning, prioritising and communicating on incidents.
* Key Responsibilities


**3\.1 Incident, Request and Escalation Management**
* Provide L2\-level technical support, diagnosis and troubleshooting for end\-user issues raised across all supported geographies.
* Own, manage and resolve incidents and service requests logged through Zendesk and Freshworks (Freshservice), ensuring resolution within agreed service level agreements.
* Act as the escalation point for L1 analysts; validate the accuracy of triage, provide guidance, and take handover of complex or ageing tickets.
* Prioritise and categorise tickets correctly based on business impact, urgency, VIP status and regional criticality.
* Escalate to L3 teams, infrastructure specialists or external vendors where required, retaining ownership of the user communication and follow\-through until closure.
* Maintain timely, accurate and professional updates in the ticketing system so that users and stakeholders in any region have visibility of progress.


**3\.2 Endpoint and Device Management**
* Administer, configure and troubleshoot corporate devices through Microsoft Intune, including enrolment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment and conditional access issues.
* Support Windows and macOS endpoints, covering operating system issues, patching, driver and peripheral faults, performance degradation and profile corruption.
* Manage device lifecycle activities such as provisioning, imaging, re\-imaging, remote wipe, retirement and asset record accuracy for users across all supported countries.
* Troubleshoot mobile device management issues on corporate and BYOD devices in line with organisational policy.
* Provide support for collaboration and productivity platforms, including Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint, along with identity and access issues in Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory.
* Diagnose network connectivity and remote access issues, including Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS and printing, coordinating with network teams where required.


**3\.3 Endpoint Security and Compliance**
* Monitor, triage and respond to endpoint security alerts and incidents raised through SentinelOne, taking appropriate containment action in accordance with defined runbooks.
* Investigate detections, perform initial analysis, quarantine or isolate affected endpoints and escalate confirmed threats to the information security team.
* Support security hygiene activities such as agent health verification, policy compliance checks, patch compliance reporting and remediation follow\-up.
* Ensure that all support activity is carried out in line with organisational information security, data protection and access control policies, recognising that regional data handling requirements may differ.


**3\.4 Stakeholder Coordination and Global Communication**
* Coordinate with team leads, regional IT contacts and senior stakeholders to drive resolution of complex, high\-impact or escalated technical issues.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with users of differing technical backgrounds, adapting tone and language to the audience while maintaining a consistent service standard across all regions.
* Provide structured handover at shift change so that in\-flight incidents transition seamlessly between engineers in the follow\-the\-sun model.
* Participate in major incident calls and bridge conversations when required, providing accurate status updates and endpoint\-level diagnostics.
* Support onboarding and offboarding activity for joiners and leavers across all supported locations, ensuring timely and compliant completion.


**3\.5 Documentation, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**
* Document root cause, diagnostic steps and resolution detail for every ticket, maintaining records to a standard suitable for audit and reporting purposes.
* Create and maintain knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures and self\-help content to enable L1 shift\-left and user self\-service.
* Identify recurring and trending issues, contribute to formal root\-cause analysis and propose permanent corrective actions.
* Contribute to automation and process improvement initiatives that reduce ticket volume, manual effort and resolution time.
* Support periodic reporting on ticket volumes, SLA attainment, backlog and regional service performance as required by leadership.
* Required Skills and Technical Competencies
* 4–5 years of demonstrable experience in a Service Desk, IT Support or End\-User Computing role, with at least 2 years operating at L2 level.
* Prior experience supporting an international or multi\-region user base, preferably including North America, EMEA or APAC locations.
* Hands\-on administration experience with Microsoft Intune, covering device enrolment, compliance and configuration policies, and application deployment.
* Working knowledge of SentinelOne or an equivalent endpoint detection and response (EDR) platform, including alert triage and containment actions.
* Practical experience with enterprise ticketing platforms, specifically Zendesk and Freshworks (Freshservice), including queue management and SLA workflows.
* Strong troubleshooting capability across Windows and macOS operating systems, endpoint hardware, peripherals and commonly used business applications.
* Sound understanding of Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 administration, group policy and role\-based access management.

**Responsibilities**
 Ticketing, Queue, and SLA Management

 User Support and Troubleshooting
   

  

* Provide support via email, phone, and remote sessions for application, access, and connectivity issues.
* Implement workarounds and permanent fixes; coordinate callbacks/voicemail return.
* Guide users through client VPN setup and connectivity validation; update entitlements/policies as required.

* Administer users across production and UAT/cert (create/disable/update, roles, groups).
* Perform password resets and SSO troubleshooting across applications/regions.

 Client Communications and Reporting
   

  

* Draft/send client communications during service events; participate in service bridges.
* Produce operational reports (logins, registrations, access/usage, user inventory).
* Maintain client/sponsor contacts; schedule meetings to progress open items.


 Documentation, Knowledge, and Governance
   

  

* Update/maintain KB pages and SOPs for repeatable tasks.
* Run audit reports for compliance and client requests; coordinate with application SMEs.
* Track team KPIs (SLA, volumes, satisfaction, escalations) and improve dashboards/reporting.


 Monitoring and Operational Readiness
   

  

* Validate daily application readiness by 7:00 AM ET; coordinate remediation before market open.
* Tune monitoring alerts (adds/removals/adjustments) to reduce noise and improve signal.


 Collaboration and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Partner with Client Services on escalations; assist peers via team chat and ad hoc coaching.
* Contribute to service bridge execution; complete incident forms and document actions/next steps.
* Support knowledge assessments, skills development plans, and bi\-weekly cross\-functional training.


 Success Measures (KPIs)
   

  

* SLA performance: on\-time resolution; minimal aged tickets.
* Queue health: low reopen rate; accurate categorization; clear next steps.
* Client satisfaction: positive feedback; reduced escalations.
* MTTR/MTTA: faster response and resolution for priority issues.
* Documentation freshness: current SOPs, playbooks, and Knowledge articles.


**Qualifications (Must\-Have)**
